openIntro: A short walk through your own data, with a few questions along the way. It is made from the data on this computer only.
unreachable: We could not reach the study's server just now. Your data is safe on this computer; please try again in a moment.
none: There is no story for this study.
nothingYet: Your story needs a bit of data first. Add the data the study asks for, and come back.
keys: Tip: you can also use the arrow keys.
required: Please answer this question to go on.
numberInvalid: That is not a number we can use here.
answersNote: Your answers stay on this computer. They are only shared if you choose to share your data, and you see them before you do.
endText: Thank you for looking. You can look around in your data whenever you like, and see what you would share with the researchers.
noData: There is no data for this part of the story.
